paragraphs: [Bava Kamma 82a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.82a.2): Rabbi Tanchum and Rabbi Berais spoke in the name of an elder — and who is he? Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads R′ Nachum and Rabbi Berais.[^1]

notes.text: In the version taught by Rav Geviha of Bei Katil, the two speakers are Rabbi Tanchum and Rabbi Biryais, and the elder is identified as Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. Hyman reports the alternate Nachum reading from Dikdukei Soferim.
